map.根据火场态势与建筑条件，推荐通风排烟战术方式与操作要点: Recommend ventilation and smoke-exhaust tactics and operating key points from the fire situation and building conditions.
map.全套（排烟机+高喷车）: Full set (smoke fan + aerial monitor truck)
map.原理：在入口设置风机正压送风，从排烟口排出烟气: Principle: set a fan at the inlet for positive-pressure supply and discharge smoke through the exhaust opening
map.优点：排烟速度快、改善能见度、降低温度: Advantages: fast smoke removal, improved visibility, lower temperature
map.条件：必须有明确的进风口和排烟口，火势须受控: Conditions: there must be a clear inlet and exhaust opening, and the fire must be under control
map.原理：利用热压差和风压，开启外窗/排烟窗自然排出: Principle: use thermal pressure difference and wind pressure; open exterior windows/smoke vents to exhaust naturally
map.优点：无需设备、操作简单: Advantages: no equipment needed, simple to operate
map.局限：受气象条件影响大，排烟效率低: Limitations: strongly affected by weather conditions, low exhaust efficiency
map.原理：利用雾状水流的引射效应带动烟气排出: Principle: use the entrainment effect of a fog stream to drive smoke out
map.优点：可降温除尘、适用密闭空间: Advantages: cools and removes dust, suitable for sealed spaces
map.注意：水量过大可能破坏热平衡，加重水渍损失: Caution: excessive water may disrupt the thermal balance and worsen water-damage losses
map.通风排烟与火势控制须协调进行！不当通风可能导致火势突然增大（回燃/轰燃风险），必: Ventilation/smoke exhaust and fire control must be coordinated! Improper ventilation may cause a sudden fire growth (backdraft/flashover risk), so it must be done under water cover.
map.内攻前按建筑类型、火灾阶段与烟气程度选择正压送风或自然排烟。: Before interior attack, choose positive-pressure ventilation or natural smoke exhaust by building type, fire stage and smoke level.
map.规划进风口与排烟口的位置、面积比与开启顺序。: Plan the positions, area ratio and opening sequence of the inlet and exhaust openings.
map.训练演示排烟引发火势扩大的风险与防控要点。: In training, demonstrate the risk of smoke exhaust causing fire growth and the key control points.
map.普通住宅/办公、烟气中等的排烟: Smoke exhaust for ordinary residential/office with moderate smoke
map.按默认参数（普通住宅办公、发展阶段、烟气程度中）：推荐 2 种方式——优先级 1: With the default parameters (ordinary residential/office, growth stage, moderate smoke): 2 methods are recommended — priority 1 positive-pressure ventilation (PPV): set a fan at one inlet for positive-pressure supply and breach/open one exhaust opening to form a directed airflow; priority 2 hydraulic smoke exhaust: use a fog stream at the exhaust opening for entrainment, cooling and dust removal. Operating key points: open the exhaust opening before the inlet to prevent backflow; keep the inlet upwind and low and the exhaust opening downwind and high; area ratio 2-3×.
map.为什么先开排烟口再开进风口？: Why open the exhaust opening before the inlet?
map.先开排烟口再送风可形成由进风口指向排烟口的定向气流，避免烟气被正压挤入未控区域或: Opening the exhaust opening before supplying air creates a directed airflow from the inlet toward the exhaust opening, preventing smoke from being pushed by positive pressure into uncontrolled areas or backflowing to injure people; reversing the order easily spreads smoke.
map.正压送风风机风量怎么选？: How to choose the airflow of a positive-pressure fan?
map.普通建筑建议 ≥10000 m³/h，大空间 ≥30000 m³/h，并应与排烟: For ordinary buildings ≥10000 m³/h is recommended and for large spaces ≥30000 m³/h, and it should match the exhaust-opening area to establish a stable directed airflow and effectively discharge smoke.
map.根据建筑类型、火灾阶段、烟气程度和装备条件，推荐正压送风、自然排烟或水力排烟方式: Based on building type, fire stage, smoke level and equipment conditions, recommend positive-pressure ventilation, natural smoke exhaust or hydraulic smoke exhaust with operating steps.
